integrity: The proof is self-contained; accompanying exact finite tests corroborate the formulas and do not substitute for an infinite-family proof. Historical priority has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the full unweighted isotropic decomposable cone in even symplectic dimension at least six. It does not provide closed multiplicities for all Fourier levels, weighted-subset stability, higher exterior powers, or an independent mathematical audit. The bounded literature comparison leaves a historical-priority risk from more general symplectic code-weight or association-scheme results.
title: Sharp inversion stability for isotropic-Plucker convolution over finite symplectic spaces
